label: 20. While Elegg and Hammering are off investigating,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: While Elegg and Hammering are off investigating,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: let's take this time to have a quick chat!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You want to slack off while everyone else is working?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If it's bothering you that much, why don't you go help the others?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Ugh, I've caught an illness that makes you not want to work!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What do you think happened to Indivilia and Chatterbox?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Not sure.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Even if they're capable of self-recovery, they're gonna need a good chunk of time to recuperate.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whoa, didn't you destroy them?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Almost, but not completely.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Unfortunately, I didn't finish the job.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You kicked some serious butt back there, that's for sure!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It must be a real bummer though,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: since you can't power up or anything anymore.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'd be lying if I said I'm not disappointed by what happened

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: in numerous ways.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Not just the loss of strength, but parting ways stings even more.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But this ability is dangerous and risky.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How did you meet with Red Hood?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's a long story.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'll tell you when I have time.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'd like you to hear that story as well, Commander.
I'll be there.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We've been told there are some unknown remnants left in your core.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's not a problem.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If I were to guess...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'd say it's probably the last vestiges of Red Hood.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Perhaps it's my attachment that's holding onto her.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Dang, you're still as cool as ever. Heck, cooler, even!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You haven't seen anything yet.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oooh! Exciting!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Rapi, bragging? I never thought I'd see the day!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Looks like they need some help over there.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Let's go give them a hand, shall we?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger.
